title: Human hERG / Kv11.1
representation: Resolved C-alpha backbone with deposited ligand heavy atoms; no docking
orientation: A rigid camera-oriented frame estimated from long helices, not an experimental membrane placement.

region.label: Supported inner-pore region
region.definition: Centroid of the C-alpha atoms of Y652 and F656 in the tetramer. This regional marker is not a docked or experimentally observed drug pose.

limitations: A fixed experimental snapshot. Missing residues, side chains, glycans, water and unrelated small molecules are omitted; the camera moves but protein coordinates do not deform. A displayed regional halo never represents an atomically resolved drug pose.
